notes: BWXT's revenue base is heavily DOE/NNSA Naval Reactors and DOE site-management JVs, not directly Pentagon J-Book RDT&E/Procurement PEs. The 10-K names few specific Pentagon program elements; instead the narrative is anchored on (a) the U.S. Navy 30-year shipbuilding plan (Columbia / Virginia / Ford-class nuclear propulsion fuel and components), (b) Government Operations backlog tied to DOE site M&O joint ventures, and (c) advanced reactor / space-nuclear / medical isotope (Mo-99) development programs. The J-Book PE corpus (410 PEs) does not enumerate Navy Atomic Energy SCN/RDTE or DOE/NNSA Naval Reactors line items, so NOT_FOUND on those is expected (treat as UNVERIFIABLE per Rubric #7). The DOE-side companion source (doe_budget) has a SC (Office of Science) corpus that is partially relevant for isotope claims. Counterparty/facility/patent control claims are extracted as well.
